ops.title: Handoff: tapped-means-his-tap-1, #3132 merged and live on the Mac
ops.body:
yasyf/cc-skills#3132 merged at 5144f303bcb0 on his tap on card-rmw36kfhw. lr 0.854.1 carries it; the Mac supervisor runs it. Read-back in cci 473352.

Left open:
- meta-desk's ruling on owner:m480 (cci 472644, on supervisor defect 472618). Do not post delivered=owner:m480: that row is his Chat page order, and this lane only followed its rule on a picture and his yes.
- The landing host, dar-desk-1, could not be read, so landing on this code there is unobserved. install-desk carries it.

What later readers must know: row.Tapped is his tap or a carried tap only. An exempt head has state exempt, and gates.LandsExempt reads its all-clear wait line. Facts.Admitted() still counts exempt heads, and factsOfRow sets f.Tap for them so root keeps lifting their holds.
ops.when: When resuming lane tapped-means-his-tap-1 or reading how row Tapped treats exempt heads
